title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
summary: Moments before Earth is demolished to make way for a hyperspace bypass, an ordinary Englishman is whisked off into space by his friend, who turns out to be an alien researching a very odd travel guide.
readIf: you want a short, absurd comic science fiction romp full of quotable lines.
skipIf: you want a firm plot or serious science fiction.

pairings.reason: Another British comic fantasy about the end of the world, equally full of jokes.
Pratchett's first Discworld book, with the same silly, satirical approach to fantasy.
A funnier, more earnest science fiction adventure with real science.
